description: Corrected main-store pass for Magic and Monsters, Lost Planet, Comic Book Hideout, and Cardboard Games. Adds missing current event coverage where source-supported, repairs over-projected/stale event behavior, refreshes source-health notes, and recalibrates Places/evaluation reads. No canonical JSON or app-code changes are proposed.

fields.assessment_notes: Magic and Monsters remains a real TCG-focused Mission Viejo store with unusually good source routing, but it is still a weaker personal MTG planning target than its generic WPN listing suggests. A fresh 2026-07-23 Wizards/EventLink pull still shows Friday 6:00 PM Commander Free Play on July 24 and July 31, 2026, but prior store-controlled evidence remains stronger: the official web calendar showed no MTG listings in checked future pages, and the inspected store Discord's May 31, 2026 summer schedule says Magic: The Gathering is no longer on the regular weekly schedule. Treat the WPN row as a source-health contradiction and verify-before-going lead, not as an active reliable weekly planning event. Daily/drop-in Commander may still be possible, and prerelease/promotional/cEDH items may appear, but the store is best treated as a watch/special-event candidate rather than a regular structured Magic destination.

operations.reason: Refresh Magic and Monsters Places read while preserving the accepted conservative interpretation.

cautions: Store-controlled Discord says MTG is no longer on the regular weekly schedule, which lowers personal fit.
Official web calendar absence conflicts with WPN Commander Free Play rows.
Mission Viejo distance makes this a poor default target without a stronger current special-event reason.
Drop-in play is less reliable than a structured event for solo planning.
open_questions: Does Friday Commander Free Play reliably fire despite the Discord schedule change?

fields.assessment_notes: Lost Planet remains a promising event-rich Torrance store, but the fresh 2026-07-23 Wizards/EventLink pull changes how its Friday programming should be represented. WPN shows a rotating sequence of dated Friday MTG items through September 2026: Marvel Super Heroes Level 2 Commander Party, Hobbit prerelease sealed pods, Two-Headed Giant Commander, The Hobbit Commander Party, Magic Presents, and specific Level 2 Commander dates. That supports writing dated events now and retiring the old weekly Friday Level 2 Commander projection so the calendar does not invent events on Fridays occupied by specials. Tuesday Commander remains supported by prior accepted monthly calendar/social evidence but was not refreshed by WPN in this pull, so it should remain active with a verify-current TBD rather than being retired. Lost Planet looks useful for someone willing to check the current calendar before going; proxy policy, Tuesday turnout, and solo-arrival/pod mechanics remain unresolved.

fields.assessment_notes: Comic Book Hideout now reads as a stronger practical nearby Magic candidate than the current app event list showed. Fresh 2026-07-23 Wizards/EventLink confirms the existing Sunday noon Commander row and adds two missing weekly Magic lanes: Thursday 4:00 PM Magic Under the Stars outdoor/back-patio Commander and Friday 4:00 PM Beginner Nights with borrow-deck / learn-to-play language. This aligns with prior Instagram/social evidence that the store teaches Magic and supports beginner/new-player play. The store is still a mixed comic/TCG venue rather than a pure Magic shop, but current event support, approachability signals, and Google/review texture make it a real candidate for casual play. Check Thursday space/weather, turnout, proxy policy, and pod power before relying on it as a regular home base.

fields.assessment_notes: Cardboard Games remains a real active multi-TCG store with current Magic support. Fresh 2026-07-23 Wizards/EventLink continues to support Friday 7:00 PM CBG Commander Night and Monday 7:00 PM $20 Marvel Superheroes draft. The official Cardboard calendar remains useful for special events and supports the already-captured August 8 and August 9 Hobbit prerelease Sealed events from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM; those rows should have structured times rather than Time TBD. The store still looks promising but not fully texture-resolved: Commander pod formation, proxy policy, casual-versus-competitive expectations, and any Discord/community coordination route remain unknown.
